output.headline: Provider-focused sponsor with a Midwest record and an upper-quartile pricing history; the target would be a new platform in healthcare services.
output.differentiator: Midwest is its largest region (6 of 14 deals), its median multiple paid of 15.2x is near the upper-quartile comparable, and 9 of 14 deals are provider businesses. [K:by_region, V:comps, A:angles]
output.why_them: Midwest provider specialist; pays upper-quartile multiples

acquirer_overview.title: A provider-weighted sponsor with a Midwest-heavy record
points: Financial sponsor targeting healthcare, financial services and technology, and growth business services; Fund XIV is $11.5 billion. [P:1, P:2]
14 deals across 7 active years, 11 closed (79%); 12 of 14 were control deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:years_active, K:control_share]
Provider deals are 9 of 14, and 6 of 14 were in the Midwest. [A:angles, K:by_region]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A new platform bet in a sub-sector it knows
points: Platform Build is a stated motive in 5 of 14 deals, a pattern that stands out against 23% of all deals in the file. [M:platform_build]
Margin Improvement drove 6 of 14 deals, which suits a target with a 16.8% margin and 11.0% growth. [M:margin_improvement, X:target]
Has bought in this or a neighbouring region (a modest factor). It has no open platform in the sub-sector, so the target would be a new platform. [S:geo_fit, A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Midwest provider precedents, including one in the target's own sub-sector
points: Sterling Health Systems: $911M bolt-on, 2018, Midwest, same sub-sector as the target, 12.2x EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2018-0357]
Golden Orthodontics: $588M leveraged buyout, 2020, Midwest, 15.2x EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2020-0276]
Zenith Specialty Care: $76M Midwest bolt-on in 2023 at 8.9x, withdrawn. Only 4 of 14 deals sit in the $100M-$400M size band. [D:MA-2023-0279, K:size_band]

valuation_context.title: A 75th-percentile price is defensible, but the return at the ask is tight
points: Comparable deals (70) range from 10.7x at the 25th percentile to 15.3x at the 75th, with a median of 12.8x. [V:comps]
The target's 16.8% margin beats the comparable median of 12.9%, which supports the 75th percentile. Its own median paid is 15.2x. [V:comps]
At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M and IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: At the same exit multiple the maximum is $193M, so the bid depends on a platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: No open platform
risk_flags.concern: It has no open platform in the target's sub-sector. [A:angles]
risk_flags.mitigant: Provider specialist, with 1 own-sub-sector deal and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [T:record]
risk_flags.reality: It would be buying a new platform, not an add-on, which weakens the conviction. [C:conviction]

risk_flags.title: Execution and priority
risk_flags.concern: Only 11 of 14 deals closed, and share of deals closed is a slight factor against. [K:closed_share, S:close_rate_s]
risk_flags.mitigant: 12 of 14 were control deals, and 5 closed bolt-ons are on record. [K:control_share, T:record]
risk_flags.reality: It ranks 8th on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 3.8%. [R:rank]

conviction.rationale: One deal in the target's own sub-sector and eight in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the fit. There is no open platform in the sub-sector, and GTCR ranks 8th on the priority list. [C:conviction, R:rank]
